title.narrative: Innovations for Social Accountability in Cambodia (ISAC)

description.narrative: (Cambodia): The Innovations for Social Accountability in Cambodia (ISAC) activity expands citizen participation and engagement to hold local governments accountable for public services (e.g., health, education, administrative and other services) through improved access to credible information, increased engagement and dialogue of citizens with their local officials, and the application of social media and technologies to increase transparency, accountability, and governance. ISAC also enhances independent media through the creation of a safe digital platform for reporting on government performance, supports existing independent media outlets, and trains citizen journalists as content creators and data curators. ..FHI 360 implements ISAC. USAID awarded ISAC through a competitive process in which the offeror with the best value to the U.S. government was selected, in accordance with federal procurement regulations...By empowering citizens to improve health, education, and administrative services through social accountability interventions, ISAC supports USAID/Cambodia's CDCS 2020-2025 Development Objective 3, "Human rights protected and government accountability advanced". In addition, this activity supports the ICS Mission Objective 3.2, sub-objective 3.2.2, "by 2024, civic participation, action for reforms, and public oversight of government institutions (particularly at the grassroots) strengthened". It also supports the Indo-Pacific Strategy Goal 1: "Advance a free and open Indo-Pacific". ISAC supports multiple administration's priorities, including 1) Upholding universal values and promoting human dignity; 2) Renewing and championing democracy and human rights, promoting transparent and accountable systems responsive to their citizens, and addressing disinformation; and 3) Championing equity and inclusion for all, to counter discrimination and social inequity.....
